steps.title: The gate opens to your fob, at any hour.
steps.text: Hold the fob to the reader on the left pillar; the gate slides open and closes behind you.

steps.title: The aisle lights come up ahead of you as you drive in.
steps.text: Drive slowly down the middle; the bays are numbered on the floor in front of each one.

steps.title: Leave by the side door.
steps.text: It opens from inside without a fob and locks behind you.

visitInfo.intro: Under the railway arches on Wharf Street.

steps: Turn right onto Wharf Street; the arches are on the left

access.label: Step-free from the mews into the hall
A side door that opens from inside without a fob

visitInfo.accessNote: The aisle is 6 m wide, with room to open doors fully beside a free bay.

questions.a: Pick your car at the top of the page: the free bays it fits light up, with the room either side. Bays are 2.4 to 2.8 m wide and 5.2 m deep.

questions.q: Can I get to my car at night?
questions.a: Yes, at any hour, by fob. Viewings are 8am to 8pm.

questions.q: Can I charge an electric car?
questions.a: Six bays have chargers: five at 7 kW and bay 14 at 22 kW. Plug in by 10pm and it’s charged by 7am.

questions.q: What do I tell my insurer?
questions.a: The hall’s address as the car’s overnight address. We can send a letter describing the security if your insurer asks.

questions.q: How long do I have to stay?
questions.a: Month to month, with a month’s notice either way.
Not tonight: our bays are 5.2 m deep. Join the waiting list and we’ll tell you when a longer bay is free.

insurerLetter.label: Our security, in a letter for your insurer

items.text: Easy to get in at night and the car was charged every morning.
